scope: BCM70015 stock SET_SINGLE_FIELD, direct field/scaled-field and full-height readback

procedure.build: c++ -std=c++11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -D__LINUX_USER__ -Iinclude -Ilinux_lib/libcrystalhd tests/fw-single-field-decode.cpp $(pkg-config --cflags --libs libavformat libavcodec libavutil glib-2.0) -Llinux_lib/libcrystalhd -lcrystalhd -o /absolute/new/probe
procedure.restore_boundary: successful STOP, reset SingleField=0, CLOSE, device close
procedure.outputs: new O_EXCL .yuy2 and .tsv files; copied active rows after extent validation, lease released before file I/O
procedure.comparison: match each single-field (opaque input token, field polarity) to its baseline; compare every active packed YUY2 byte
procedure.tokens: input packet identifiers in 100000-unit increments, not measured presentation timestamps
procedure.geometry: native_api_geometry and TSV coded_field_rows (initial probe) / coded_output_rows (extended probe) describe the API-reported dimensions; they do not independently measure SPS storage height
procedure.parity: top/bottom counts use native PIB field flags; pixel equality is against the native paired-field baseline

cases.input: existing H.264 High MBAFF 1920x1080i25, 2 seconds; stream-level tt but mixed per-picture SEI
cases.field_order_correction: Initially labelled TFF from stream metadata; a complete SEI census found pic_struct=3 on 16 pictures and 4 on 34. This is not a uniform-TFF acceptance case.

cases.generate: ffmpeg -nostdin -hide_banner -loglevel error -n -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=720x480:rate=60 -t 2 -vf tinterlace=mode=interleave_bottom -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 18 -flags +ilme+ildct -x264-params bff=1:keyint=30:min-keyint=30:scenecut=0 -an -f mpegts OUTPUT.ts

cases.input: uniform TFF H.264 High MBAFF 1920x1080i25, 2 seconds
cases.generate: ffmpeg -nostdin -hide_banner -loglevel error -n -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1920x1080:rate=50 -t 2 -vf tinterlace=mode=interleave_top -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 18 -flags +ilme+ildct -x264-params tff=1:pic-struct=1:keyint=25:min-keyint=25:scenecut=0 -an -f mpegts OUTPUT.ts
cases.timing_limit: Derived from 40 ms picture PTS and TFF parity, not measured output-arrival or display cadence

cases.input: same uniform TFF FHD fixture, decoder-mediated scale width 960
cases.limit: Field scaling and omission, not full-height/full-field-rate Bob or a measured speedup

va_adapter_observation.fixture: same original 50-picture mixed-SEI FHD input, not the later uniform-TFF fixture
va_adapter_observation.pipeline: strict FFmpeg VA decode -> hwdownload NV12 -> framehash

single_one.result: FAIL: different input identities cannot form a VA field pair

full_height_observation.input: uniform TFF H.264 High MBAFF 1280x720i25, 2 seconds; synthetic geometry, not broadcast-format qualification
full_height_observation.generate: Use the uniform-TFF case generation command with testsrc2 size=1280x720, retaining rate=50 and all other options

initial_strict_frame_attempt.result: FAIL: first full-height lease rejected because API flags=0x70 indicate TOPFIELD, not the assumed FRAME/FIELDPAIR metadata

full_height_observation.contract: Observe exactly 1280x720 interlaced-flagged full-height payload, completed extent plus raw PIB scalar bounds, exact width/line trailers, one output per token; not a progressive-frame metadata assertion
full_height_observation.interpretation: Both original fields remain in alternating rows: exact full-height luma Weave at 25 picture PTS/s, not Bob at 50 progressive outputs/s. Single-field mode changes neither pixels nor count on this source-width path. Library field-mask handling adds INTERLACED and rewrites FIELDPAIR to TOPFIELD (raw 0x48 -> API 0x70).
full_height_observation.chroma_limit: Full-height luma is exact; hardware YUY2 chroma is not bit-exact to software decode after common interlaced-bilinear YUV420p normalization. No physical picture-quality claim.

unchanged_va_adapter.pipeline: strict FFmpeg VA decode -> hwdownload NV12 -> framehash; no preload/single-field override
unchanged_va_adapter.result: FAIL: decode/sync/download status 23; destroy context also reports 23

targeted_debug_repeat.first_rejection: H.264 fields have mismatched identity, parity, order or geometry
targeted_debug_repeat.limit: VA uses coded height 736, unlike the direct probe's exact 720-row setup; full-payload bounds and visible cropping at 736 need their own qualification before any adapter change

conclusion: On the tested field-output routes the recognized command selects one unchanged field per picture, with alternating polarity; it halves active field payload but does not provide Bob. Decoder-mediated scaling also works. The separately tested 1280x720 source-width path returns whole-picture Weave in both command modes despite TOPFIELD API metadata; the existing VA adapter does not accept this case.
not_established: smooth presentation, physical A/V or a throughput/latency speedup
other codecs, firmware revisions or BCM70012
standalone MFD/SCL operation or physical PPB leasing
